router.whenToUse: Classify every new Foreman task and select one configured worker profile.

ordinary.whenToUse: Mechanical edits, initial bug investigation and fixes, features within an existing design, UI, tests, and reviews. Use when the brief does not establish a need for deep redesign; file count alone does not make a task deep.

deep.whenToUse: New architecture or data-model design, difficult concurrency or security reasoning, or a bug still unexplained after earlier investigation. File count or initial investigation alone is not enough.

codex-sol.whenToUse: Use for tooling-heavy builds, tests, dependencies, CI, or scripted batch edits when this profile is explicitly requested.

codex-luna.whenToUse: Preferred within its group unless another tool is explicitly requested or needs native capabilities this tool lacks.

opencode-sol.whenToUse: Use when OpenCode is explicitly requested.

opencode-luna.whenToUse: Use for OpenCode V2 tasks when the Luna model is requested.

claude-sonnet.whenToUse: Use when Claude is explicitly requested or codex-luna is not active.

claude-opus.whenToUse: Use for architecture, migration, concurrency, or security work in this group.
